dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple closed 'O' and semi-closed 'C' shaped structures with high-contrast, light-gray perimeters. The geometry is predominantly irregular-elliptical with sharp pixel-level transitions from the bright outer ring to the dark interior core.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low to moderate density of isolated, high-intensity white pixel clusters lacking internal gradients, primarily located in the anterior-dorsal region and within the interior of larger macro-annuli.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the four most prominent dorsal rings form an irregular, non-equilateral quadrilateral with the longest axis oriented parallel to the subject's spine.
